# Aithor

> Aithor is an AI-powered essay writing platform with multilingual support, offering undetectable essay generation, research assistance, and academic writing tools including citation formatting, plagiarism detection, and grammar checking.

Aithor provides a comprehensive AI essay writer available in 16+ languages and locales. The platform combines essay generation with research tools, citation management (MLA, APA, Chicago), plagiarism detection, AI humanization, and grammar checking to support academic writing across global markets.

## Key Topics

- AI Essay Writer
- Essay Generator
- Citation Generator
- Plagiarism Checker
- Grammar Checker
- AI Humanizer
- AI Detector
- Paraphraser
- Research Assistant
- Academic Writing
- MLA/APA/Chicago Citations
- Originality Checker
- Literature Review
- Machine Learning
- Free Essay Tool

## Core Platform

- [AI Essay Writer | Undetectable AI Essay Generator – Aithor](https://aithor.com): Aithor AI essay writer with research assistant, citation tools (MLA, APA, Chicago)
